meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把混乱的代码拆解重组，理清结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头代码越改越乱，想在不改行为的前提下梳理结构
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code apart and rebuild it into clear structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has grown messy and you want to reorganize it without changing behavior

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先问清你的重构目标,扫描代码库画出依赖图、评估测试覆盖,再逐步执行重构,每步跑测试和类型检查,验证失败就停下并回退。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化或抽取代码时接管;若请求含糊(如只说「清理一下」),它会先反问具体想改什么。

say.note: 先分析依赖,再给出分步重构计划
按整个项目范围重构这个类

say.text: 把校验逻辑抽成独立模块,--strategy=safe
say.note: 保守策略,每步跑测试验证

howto.what_en: After install, Claude asks what you want to change, scans the codebase for dependencies and test coverage, plans atomic steps, then refactors step by step, running tests and type checks after each change and stopping on failure.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, or extract code. If the request is vague like 'clean up', it asks clarifying questions first.

say_en.note: Analyzes dependencies, then gives a step-by-step plan
Refactors this class across the whole project

say_en.text: Extract validation logic into its own module --strategy=safe
say_en.note: Conservative mode; runs tests after each step
